<DOCSTRING>
Creates a new instance of the signer to be used. The default implementation uses the :class:`.Signer` base class.

Args:
    salt (str | bytes | None): The salt used for signing. If None, the default salt from the instance is used.

Returns:
    Signer: A new signer instance configured with the provided salt and other instance-specific parameters.
</DOCSTRING>
